IL_0000: ldstr "# StarQ Workflow Kit
This mod is primarily to be used by prefab asset creators.

This mod modify prefabs in an irreversible way. So, make sure to Backup your local prefabs in case anything goes wrong.

## Features
- Prefab Saver: Resave prefab to remove the pesky "m_LargeIcon" and/or "m_FireHazard" issue from any prefab files, create CID if missing or convert prefabs from Text format to Binary format and vice versa.
- Prefab Packager: Create COK packages from folders, optionally bypass the mod/DLC check to make the process faster.
- Enable Manual Upload: Activate a hidden Editor feature that allows adding anything else with the published assets.
- Prefab Modifier: Bulk prefab modification to add UI Icons, PlaceableObject, UIGroup, EditorAssetCategoryOverride, AssetPack, SpawnableObject; remove ObsoleteIdentifiers, SpawnableObject, AssetPack.
- Bulk Rename Prefab: Bulk rename prefabs safely by adding ObsoleteIdentifiers.
- Locale Maker: Create vanilla localization files from JSON (I18N) locale.
- Optional 'EditorAssetCategoryOverride' for all assets based on its prefab type.
- ~~[REMOVED since 1.5.2f1] Auto (Harmony Patch): Sort custom asset's EditorAssetCategoryOverride alphabetically.~~
- ~~[REMOVED since 1.5.2f1] Auto (Harmony Patch): View hidden configurations ([HideInEditor] attribute) on the Editor Inspector panel, now suffixed with '[*H]'.~~
- ~~[REMOVED since 1.5.2f1] That's all... Oh, and the PDX upload script.~~
